hypotheses.expect: A timeout inside the bus process reaches the bus_client's caller as a TimeoutError, so a ticket asking a slow chart or verdict gate waits on its own berth instead of dying at the reply timeout.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a call the bus process answers with 'TimeoutError: <words>' raises TimeoutError whose message is exactly <words>; (2) any other refusal still raises RuntimeError('bus process: ...'), and 'LookupError: ...' still raises LookupError; (3) a request through reach(), from a far client and from a local one, raises TimeoutError when the bus process timed out
hypotheses.piece: D1: RemoteBus._call maps 'TimeoutError: ' back to TimeoutError, beside the LookupError mapping.
